metadata.name: loopscale-collateral-mispricing
metadata.description: Collateral-mispricing bad-debt pressure replay against the shipped Solana lending fork. The borrower opens a position when the oracle reports an inflated collateral price (200), borrowing 13500 against 100 collateral (healthy under the inflated regime). At tick 1 the oracle realizes the true price (100) — the position becomes underwater (health factor ~ 5926 bps). At tick 2 the liquidator settles: the seized collateral is far below repay+bonus value, so bad debt accrues at the pool level and the collateral_health invariant fires. Historical inspiration: the April 2025 Loopscale exploit (~$5.8M), where LP-token NAV mispricing enabled undercollateralized loans on Solana. Honest boundary: economic-shape replay on Riptide's Solend-fork toy lending program, NOT a byte-level reconstruction of Loopscale's mainnet program or slot state.
